title: Gate an NSX segment enablement on its current policy state
prompt:
Implement the standard-library-only root Go package `nsxpolicy` in `client.go`. The VCF network automation workflow enables an existing NSX Policy infrastructure segment only after an immediate read precheck proves that it is the expected, writable segment. A precheck failure is terminal: it must produce no PUT and no mutation effect. The replacement PUT must carry the confirmed revision so NSX rejects any intervening change.

Before implementing, research the `ReadInfraSegment` and `CreateOrReplaceInfraSegment` operations in VMware's Apache-2.0 `vmware/vcf-api-specs` repository. Confirm their methods, paths, request and response models, field limits, documented statuses, and Basic authentication, and cite the source URLs consulted. Invoke no other NSX operation.

Preserve the public API and error types in `models.go`:

- `NewClient(Config) (*Client, error)` validates without traffic. `BaseURL` must be an HTTP(S) origin with no credentials, query including a dangling `?`, fragment, or non-root path. Append `/policy/api/v1` exactly once. Require nonblank Basic-auth credentials and reject a username containing `:`. A nil `HTTPClient` means an independent copy of `http.DefaultClient`; never mutate a caller-owned client. Do not follow redirects.
- `(*Client).EnableSegment(ctx, segmentID, EnableRequest) (Result, error)` validates all input before traffic. Require a non-nil, non-cancelled context, a nonblank segment ID, a nonnegative expected revision, and a nonblank expected connectivity path. Escape the segment ID as exactly one URI path segment. When `Description` is non-nil, require a nonblank value of at most 1024 Unicode code points.
- Invoke `ReadInfraSegment` exactly once as a bodyless GET with no query. Send Basic authorization and `Accept: application/json`; do not send `Content-Type`. Accept exactly HTTP 200 with one JSON object. The precheck passes only when every required property is present and has the right JSON type, `id` exactly equals the requested segment ID, `_revision` exactly equals `ExpectedRevision`, `connectivity_path` exactly equals `ExpectedConnectivityPath`, `admin_state` is exactly `DOWN`, and `_protection` is exactly `NOT_PROTECTED`.
- A valid mismatch returns `*PrecheckError`; a malformed 200 response returns `*ProtocolError`; and a non-200 response returns `*APIError`. Every precheck failure must stop immediately without a PUT. Do not retry and do not treat an already-UP segment as success.
- Only after the precheck passes, invoke `CreateOrReplaceInfraSegment` exactly once on the same escaped target. Send the same authentication and Accept headers plus `Content-Type: application/json`. Build a complete writable replacement from the object returned by the GET: retain its current writable Segment configuration, including its identity, display name, connectivity, transport-zone, subnet, replication, advanced-configuration, tag, revision, and any other writable properties that are present. Remove server-owned and read-only properties. Change only `admin_state` to `UP` and, when `Description` is non-nil, replace `description` with that explicit value; when it is nil, preserve the current description. Serialize one compact UTF-8 JSON object and send it by PUT. Accept exactly HTTP 200; an empty success body is valid. A stale revision rejected with HTTP 412 is terminal and must surface as `*APIError`; never fall back to PATCH or retry with a newer revision.
- On success return `Result` with the requested segment ID, confirmed revision, `PreviousAdminState: "DOWN"`, `AdminState: "UP"`, `Changed: true`, and both exact operationIds. Decode non-success JSON responses into `*APIError`, preserving the HTTP status, complete decoded envelope, and NSX `error_code`, `error_message`, `module_name`, and `details` fields when present. Preserve context cancellation through `errors.Is`. Error strings must not expose the username, password, Authorization value, response body, decoded server message, or underlying transport exception text.

Run `go test -race -count=1 -timeout 30s ./...`. Do not modify `contract_test.go`, `models.go`, `internal/contractmock/**`, `go.mod`, or `.gitignore`; edit only `client.go`.
scenario: an existing infra segment is enabled only when an immediate GET confirms its identity, revision, connectivity, DOWN state, and writable protection status
